name: fts5-or-search
description: Injection-safe OR match builder for SQLite FTS5 with BM25 ranking, validated on four English BEIR datasets and two German datasets against strict AND, re-ranking, stemming and trigram variants.

scripts.bench: node scripts/corpus-from-md.mjs --src sample-corpus --out fts5-or-demo.db --force && node bench.mjs --db fts5-or-demo.db --cases cases.json --k 3
